summary.result: And the results were in fair conditions for all the tested watersheds which differ considerably in their sizes, landuse types, and physiological features.
summary.background: The Objectives of this paper were to develop a modified tank model that is capable of simulating daily streamflow from a small watershed using daily watershed evapotranspiration and to test the applicability of the model to different watersheds.
